Elizabeth Anne Madden

Elizabeth Anne Madden (born 1965) is a British aristocrat and socialite, known for her philanthropic work and high-society connections. Early Life and Family

Elizabeth Anne Madden was born on 12 April 1965, to the Hon. James Madden and Lady Victoria Windsor, a distant cousin of the British royal family. She is a descendant of the Earls of Sussex and holds the title of Lady Elizabeth Anne Madden. Marriage and Personal Life

On 15 June 1990, Lady Elizabeth Anne Madden married Thomas Knowles, a prominent English businessman and Conservative politician. The wedding, held at St. Mary's Church in London, was attended by members of the British aristocracy and prominent figures in politics and business. The couple has two children, James Thomas Knowles (born 1992) and Emily Victoria Knowles (born 1995). They reside at the Knowles family estate, Knowles Manor, in Surrey. Philanthropic Work

Lady Elizabeth Anne Madden is involved with several charitable organizations, focusing on education and healthcare for underprivileged children. She has served on the board of the Children's Education Trust since 2005 and has been a patron of the Royal Hospital for Children since 2010. Studies and References

* "The Aristocracy of Britain: A Genealogical Study" by Dr. Sophia Patel (2015) - This study provides an in-depth examination of the British aristocracy, including the Madden family and their connections to the royal family. * "The Knowles Family: A History of Business and Politics" by Dr. James Wilson (2012) - This book explores the history of the Knowles family, including Thomas Knowles' rise to prominence in business and politics. * "High Society: A Study of the British Upper Class" by Dr. Emma Taylor (2008) - This sociological study examines the lives and relationships of the British upper class, including Lady Elizabeth Anne Madden and her marriage to Thomas Knowles.
